commits.subject: Merge main into shared test expectation cleanup
Merge main into shared test expectation cleanup

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

metadata.body:
Working towards https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/issues/3484

Replace six concrete agent-extension checks in shared AWS SDK and JDBC tests with expectation hooks. This is standalone preparatory cleanup for separating testing infrastructure; no modules, dependencies, or production behavior change.

- **AWS SDK:** Reuse existing hooks with explicit agent-fixture overrides, preserving instrumentation properties for agent/autoconfigure fixtures and builder-aligned test properties for library fixtures.
- **JDBC:** Add a narrowly scoped hook for SQLite connection-initialization spans, enabled only by the agent fixture.
metadata.title: Decouple shared test expectations from AgentInstrumentationExtension
